title: Text responses without ads
summary:
Text responses lose the ad wrapper, while the image editor and Enter navigation get a little tidier.

The ad system was disabled for regular and streaming responses from text.pollinations.ai. Streaming responses now pass through without the ad wrapper changing them.

The image editor moved Reference Images between the prompt and model selector, enlarged thumbnails, and made the add and remove controls clearer.

Enter standardized its “API Reference” naming and adjusted button order and colors across sign-in, dashboard, and FAQ pages.
